sable.

awards.name: Order of the Iris of Merit of Ansteorra
awards.description:
A member of the kingdom who shows outstanding work in the arts and sciences, well above that which is expected of the citizens of Ansteorra, Knowledge of the courtly graces; and
who have shown consistent respect for the laws and customs of Ansteorra.

awards.name: Order of the Laurel
awards.description: A candidate must have attained the standard of excellence in skill and/or knowledge equal to that of his or her prospective peers in an area of the Arts or Sciences. The candidate must have applied this skill and/or knowledge for the instruction of members and service to the kingdom to an extent above and beyond that normally expected of members of the Society. this is the highest award given in the SCA for excellence in the Arts and Sciences.
awards.insignia: Laurel wreath worn on the head and/or badge of the order worn as a medallion or pin. In Ansteorra, many members of the Order also wear a cloak that incorporates the badge.
awards.badge: (Fieldless) a Laurel Wreath

awards.name: Order of Defense
awards.description: This is the highest award given in the SCA for excellence in the fighting fields of either rapier and/or cut-and-thrust combat. The candidate must be considered the equal of their prospective peers with the basic weapons of rapier and/or cut-and-thrust combat. The candidate must have applied this skill and/or knowledge for the instruction of members and service to the kingdom to an extent above and beyond that normally expected of members of the Society.
awards.insignia: The official insignia is a white livery collar. Most members of the Order wear a medallion bearing the badge of the order suspended from their collar. In Ansteorra, members of the Order also wear a white short cloak that incorporates the badge.
awards.badge: (Tinctureless) Three rapiers in pall inverted tips crossed

awards.name: Award of the Queen's Rapier of Ansteorra
awards.description: Given to a member who has striven greatly to further their skill level and capabilities in rapier combat; involved in the skills of the arts and basic heraldry; and should display courtly graces, manners and chivalry. This award is given only by the Queen.
awards.insignia: A cord braided Gules and Argent tied to a metal ring worn on the belt.
awards.badge: None

awards.name: Order of the White Scarf of Ansteorra
awards.description: Given to persons who have demonstrated exceptional skill and chivalry in combat with weapons of the duello; service to Ansteorra and its people; knowledge of the courtly graces; and obedience to the laws and ideals of Ansteorra and of the Society for Creative Anachronism.
awards.insignia: A white scarf worn about the left shoulder or above the left elbow.
awards.badge: Sable, on a pale argent between two rapiers, guards to center, proper, in chief a mullet of five greater and five lesser points sable.

awards.name: Award of the Golden Bridge of Ansteorra
awards.description: Given to those members who have gone above and beyond in the areas of Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging. This award recognizes a member's efforts in making our game more inclusive and easier to access to those who have historically been marginalized or excluded.

awards.name: Nobility of the Court
awards.description:
An award given at the pleasure of the Crown for outstanding work in service, contribution and help in the kingdom, well above that which is expected of the citizens of Ansteorra;
Knowledge of the courtly graces; and who have shown consistent respect for the laws and customs of Ansteorra.
awards.insignia: A flat-topped or engrailed coronet decorated with the arms, ensign, or other badges of the barony which they rule
awards.badge: none

awards.name: Order of the Sable Garland of Ansteorra
awards.description: Patroned by a Rose of Ansteorra, the members of this Order shall have the strength of nature, the degree of martial skill, and the commitment to Ansteorra that they shall have obtained a chosen position in the Order of the Chivalry. They shall have served and promoted the honor and spirit of Ansteorra within its borders and beyond. They shall have been a vital part of the fabric of Ansteorra through service, counsel, knowledge, and shared knowledge.  They shall have used all talents and means to preserve and protect the Kingdom, the Crown, and the standards and ideals of their oaths.
awards.insignia: A sable cloak with a border, Or, upon which lies a garland of mullets of five greater and five lesser points slipped and leaved sable.
awards.badge: none

awards.name: Award of Arms
awards.description: A simple grant of arms, given in recognition of membership and participation in our game. This is usually, the first award given to a member.
awards.insignia: None officially. Many crowns present new armigers with a metal circlet/fillet of ½” height or less. Such circlets are not currently reserved or restricted insignia.
awards.badge: none

awards.name: Order of the Bastion of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who exemplify the spirit of the Dream in Vindheim and inspire the populace to greater deeds and service. The candidate should be a person that Vindheim relies upon for the betterment of the Principality, using their skills and talents, and by whose absence the Principality would be greatly deprived of a valuable member.

awards.name: Award of the Brazier of Vindheim
awards.specialties: ["Martial Endeavors as Art","Martial Endeavors as Service"]
awards.description: Persons who have used their martial skills to enhance artistry or assist the service community. The candidate should use their skills and talents to contribute to the betterment of Vindheim or its subordinate communities. The Award may be given to an individual more than once, but only for the reasons listed.

awards.name: Award of the Key of Keys of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have given especial service in attendance to the persons of the Vindheim Coronet(s). The candidate should exemplify the pinnacle of service and respect for the Vindheim Coronet(s), the laws of the Principality of Vindheim, and the Kingdom of Ansteorra.

awards.name: Award of the Key of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have faithfully served in attendance to the Vindheim Coronet(s). The candidate should exemplify faithful service and respect for the Vindheim Coronet(s), the laws of the Principality of Vindheim, and the Kingdom of Ansteorra.

awards.name: Order of the Fountain of Vindheim
awards.specialties: ["Art as Service","Art in support of Marshallate"]
awards.description: Persons who have offered public service to others and the Vindheim community through the arts and science or a martial aspect, including but not limited to bardcraft, music, vocal heraldry, and dance. The candidate should use their skills and talents to contribute to the ambiance, atmosphere, and splendor of Vindheim in our public spaces.

awards.name: Order of the Golden Comb of Vindheim
awards.description: Younger members of the Society that have not reached their majority shall be recognized for service above that which is normally expected of them.

awards.name: Order of the Goutte de Vin of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have served the Principality through provision of original award scrolls.

awards.name: Award of the Pillar of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have offered notable service to  Vindheim through the gift of their time or organizational skills. The candidate should use their skills and talents to contribute to the betterment of Vindheim or its subordinate communities.

awards.name: Order of the Sanguine Bowl of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who embody the spirit of Vindheim even though they are not residents thereof. The inductee should reside outside the borders of Vindheim and exhibit love, dedication, and service which truly embodies the Vindheim ideal.

awards.name: Award of the River of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have demonstrated excellence in period style, display, or fidelity.

awards.name: Award of the Thunderbolt of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have distinguished themselves to the Coronet in an extraordinary fashion. The candidate should show an example of phenomenal prowess, extraordinary artistry, or remarkable service.

awards.name: Award of the Wellspring of Vindheim
awards.description: Persons who have served the Principality through static arts.

awards.description: Recognition of those who take on the burden of representing Vindheim well in foreign lands. These persons shall increase the recognition or improve upon the reputation of Vindheim while engaging in service activities. The Award may be given to an individual more than once, but only once for a particular type of service.

awards.name: Award of the Dragon's Egg
awards.description: "We honor the contributions of youth to our Barony of Bryn Gwlad. Hear now, young gentles, you are hereby named a recipient of the Dragon’s Egg, in recognition of courtesy, service, and enthusiasm, that you may continue to inspire others."

awards.name: Award of the Cross Fleury
awards.description: "The warriors of Bryn Gwlad are admired for their skills and courage. These gentles have defended our lands and our people with great honor, and are hereby awarded the Cross Fleury of Bryn Gwlad."

awards.name: Award of the Golden Martlet
awards.description: "The Golden Martlet is a non-armigerous baronial award to honor service to the Barony of Bryn Gwlad."

awards.name: Award of the Muse
awards.description: "The beauty of Bryn Gwlad is a gift for all who gather here. Recipients of this award are highly admired artisans whose skills have enriched our barony, and are hereby awarded the Muse of Bryn Gwlad."

awards.name: Award of the Silver Chalice
awards.description: "The quality of one’s character is highly prized in our Society. The persona of these gentles has greatly enriched the Barony of Bryn Gwlad, and with these words are hereby awarded the Silver Chalice of Bryn Gwlad."

awards.name: Keeper of the Crucible
awards.description: "The Keeper of the Crucible is an award given by the Lord and Lady of Hellsgate to recognize works of Arts and Sciences within our Stronghold of Hellsgate."

awards.name: Keeper of the Flame
awards.description: "The Keeper of the Flame is an award given by the Lord and Lady of Hellsgate to recognize acts of service to our Stronghold of Hellsgate."

awards.name: Keeper of the Gate
awards.description: "The Keeper of the Gate is an award given by the Lord and Lady of Hellsgate to recognize skill in combat shown within our Stronghold of Hellsgate."

awards.name: Award of the Ursae Animus
awards.description: Award of the Ursae Animus (Heart of the Bear):  This is the Bjornsborg award for our closest advisors. It is given at the discretion of the B&B to those who we trust to give us the best advice on how to make the Barony better for everyone.

awards.name: Award of the Ursae Alkaid
awards.description: Award of the Ursae Alkaid (Stars of the Bear): This is an award for anyone who does something that impresses the Bjornsborg B&B, in any area of our game.

awards.name: Award of the Ursae Amicus
awards.description: Award of the Ursae Amicus (Friends of the Bear): This is a service order for those who live outside of Bjornsborg that have done service for the Barony. Given at the discretion of the B&B.

awards.name: Award of the Rising Storm of Namron
awards.description: The Rising Storm of Namron is awarded to youth members for bringing honor and glory to themselves and to the Barony through service, marshallate activities, and/or the arts and sciences.

awards.name: Award of the Torsade
awards.description: The Torsade is the Barony’s service award and is presented by the current Landed Nobility of Namron. The colors of the Torsade represent past Barons and Baronesses. This award is given when an individual has worked to help the Barony at a number of events and throughout the year in other activities, and helps to improve the Barony of Namron.
awards.insignia: Torsade

awards.name: Award of the Argent Fleur
awards.description: The Argent Fleur is an Arts and Sciences award and is presented by the current Landed Nobility of Namron. This award is given to those individuals who enrich the culture of Namron through their skill in the creation and/or performance of period items. These skills can be for a wide range of activities and talents that cover all we see and do in the SCA.
awards.insignia: Argent Fleur

awards.name: Award of the Ascia Rossa
awards.description: The Ascia Rossa is a marshalate award and is presented by the current Landed Nobility of Namron. The symbol is a red fighting axe with a black Namron storm on it. This award is given to those members in the marshallate community who bring the honor and glory to Namron and helps to protect her lands. The Premier recipient of this award is Barone Orlando. This award was designed and created by Barone Orlando and Baronessa Caterina prior to their investiture. At the step down court of Baron Donnchadh he surprised everyone by presenting the premier award to Barone Orlando before their investiture.

awards.name: The Flying Cow of Namron
awards.description: The Order of the Flying Cow is our newest award and is presented by the current Landed Nobility of Namron. This award is given to those members in the community who bring the silly joy of shenanigans to Namron and helps to make the populace and their excellencies smile. This does include a stipulation that the shenanigans should never damage property or hurt others. The Premier recipients of this award are Don Cornelius Merilainen, Honorable Lady Anastasiia Dmitrieva Sokolova, and Lord Klaus Luistra. This award was created by Baronessa Isabella and Baroness Emma at their first Beltane event as landed.

awards.name: Order of the Kriegshelt
awards.description: The Order of the Krieghelt is a polling order. All appointments are made under the counsel of the Order. This award carries no Order of Precedence (OP), but carries great prestige. It is the highest Baronial award that may be given, and is given by the Landed Nobility of Namron, for lifelong service to the Barony.
awards.badge: (Fieldless) A pile wavy couped argent

awards.name: Award of the Gilded Girnch
awards.description: This is the Eldern Hills Non-Armigerous Award recognizing service to the Barony.

awards.name: Award of the Argent Bison
awards.description: The Argent Bison, named for the white bison supported on the Baronial Achievement (coat of arms), is a special service award for individuals that have dedicated significant time to serving the Barony.

awards.name: Award of the Bison's Might
awards.description: Bison's Might is awarded by the Landed Nobility of Eldern Hills for exemplary performance of the field of combat.

awards.name: Award of the Argent Flame
awards.description: The Argent Flame is awarded by the Landed Nobility of Eldern Hills for teaching and furthering others pursuits of the arts and sciences.

awards.name: Flint and Steel of Wiesenfeuer
awards.description: Non-armigerous Baronial Service Award. Typically the first group award given for service.

awards.name: Golden Beacon of Wiesenfeuer
awards.description: Non-amigerous Baronial award given to those who give their time and knowledge in support of the marshallate activities through training, building supplies, helping others, etc.

awards.name: Flamme d’ Orleans of Wiesenfeuer
awards.description: Non-amigerous Baronial award given to those that serve the Barony with their Arts and Sciences. This is through teaching, level of skill, and using the skill to better the group.

awards.name: Spark of Wiesenfeuer
awards.description: Non-amigerous Baronial award for the youth or those that work with the youth.

awards.name: Prometheus’ Flame of Wiesenfeuer
awards.description:
Non-amigerous Baronial award for those members of the Lanternarius that continue to go beyond what is expected for years. 

Note: This is a Polling Award

awards.name: Acorn of the Steppes
awards.description: The Acorn of the Steppes is an award for service to the Barony, generally to people who are relatively new to the group, because “mighty oaks from little acorns grow.”
awards.insignia: A natural colored acorn necklace worn

awards.name: The Grice’s Track
awards.description: An award for service to the martial community of the Barony of the Steppes
awards.insignia: A gold grice's (boar's) footprint, worn as a necklace.

awards.name: The Boar’s Tusk
awards.description: An award for martial prowess in the Barony of the Steppes
awards.insignia: A natural colored tusk necklace worn as a necklace.

awards.name: The Forest Light of the Steppes
awards.description: An award for prowess in the arts and sciences in the Barony of the Steppes
awards.insignia: A charm with an abstract depiction of a diagonal beam of yellow light between green and black, worn as a necklace.

awards.name: Award of T’Anthony
awards.description: A baronial award for youths to recognize their service and efforts to support the Barony of the Steppes
awards.insignia: A large, acorn-shaped jingle bell worn as a necklace.

awards.name: Heart of the Oak
awards.description: Award for continued dedication and service to the barony, the populace and for representing the barony throughout the kingdom. Generally given to people with many years or decades of service to the Barony.
awards.insignia: A metal oak leaf with a heart attached to the center of it, worn as a necklace around the neck.

awards.name: Award of the Portcullis
awards.description: Award given for service to the Barony of Elfsea

awards.name: Award of the Azure Grail
awards.description: Given once per year, the Azure Grail is the Elfsea version of the Lion of Ansteorra, given to the person that inspires the Dream within the Barony.

awards.name: Award of the Oysters Irritant
awards.description: Given to those members of the Barony of Elfsea who have been constantly forthright in their truthfulness and opinion to the Landed Nobles and populace.

awards.name: Award of the Azure Pearl
awards.description: The Azure Pearl is given for personal service to the Landed Nobles of Elfsea.

awards.name: Award of the Eastern Tower
awards.description: Award given to recognize arts and sciences within the Barony of Elfsea; can be given multiple times.

awards.name: Award of the Western Tower
awards.description: Award given to recognize martial prowess within the Barony of Elfsea; can be given multiple times.

awards.name: Award of the Azure Peacock
awards.description: Award given to recognize great endeavors of herladry within the Barony of Elfsea; can be given multiple times.

awards.name: Award of the Or Solar
awards.description: Award given to recognize the endeavors of youth within the Barony of Elfsea; can be given multiple times.

awards.name: Award of the Crimson Tear
awards.description: Award given to recognize service within the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Crimson Spear
awards.description: Award given to recognize martial prowess within the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Golden Needle
awards.description: Award given to recognize arts and sciences within the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Golden Tower
awards.description: Award given to recognize endeavors of youth within the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Bomba of Bonwicke
awards.description: Award given to recognize exceptional acts within the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Coterie of Salt
awards.description: Award given to recognize endeavors of non-residential contributors to the Barony of Bonwicke.

awards.name: Award of the Feather of Honor
awards.description: This is the non-armigerous award of service for Raven's Fort.

awards.name: Award of the Craftsman
awards.description: This is the award for artisans in the Barony of Raven's Fort.

awards.name: Award of the Talon (RF)
awards.description: This is the local non-armigerous award for fighting in the Barony of Raven's Fort.

awards.name: Award of the Jeweled Pillar
awards.description: This award is given to recognize above and beyond dedicated service for the benefit of the Barony of Bordermarch.
awards.charter: The Jeweled Pillar, given for above and beyond Dedicated Service for the benefit of the Barony of Bordermarch, was established in the term of Baroness Melia de la Renaudiere November 2017 and joined by Co-Baroness Lessandra della Torre in November 2018.

awards.name: Award of the Shakey Knees
awards.description: Shakey knees are given to those who have their first battlefield kill at Bordermarch's War of the Rams.

awards.name: The Order of the Amber of Bordermarch
awards.description: This award is given for service to the Barony of Bordermarch well above and beyond all expectation. (Lifelong service award).

awards.name: Terick's Hammer
awards.description: A second level youth service award to the Golden Comb. The recipient of this award should already be a Golden Comb and be a youth who has continued to serve the Principality since becoming a Golden Comb.

awards.name: Order of the Griffon's Heart
awards.description: Recognition for those who have been a driving force behind recruitment and retention in Vindheim.
